# pano_sfm test fixtures

`real_metro_*.jpg`: six frames (768x384) taken at 2, 6, 10, 14, 18 and 22 s from the 3840x1920 equirect clip "Moscow metro train Sokolniki interior shot on spherical camera 2023-03" on Wikimedia Commons, by Svetlov Artem, released under CC0 1.0 (https://creativecommons.org/publicdomain/zero/1.0/). Source: https://commons.wikimedia.org/wiki/File:Moscow_metro_train_Sokolniki_interior_shot_on_spherical_camera_2023-03.MP4.webm

They are real footage, used by the blur and duplicate rejection tests. Total size is under 1 MB.
